Watch Confession on The Daily Wire.

In Stalin’s Soviet Union, speaking the wrong words could mean the difference between freedom and death. When Alexei, a former priest, is arrested in 1938 Moscow, he is taken to Lubyanka Prison for interrogation. But the man waiting to question him is someone he knows all too well: Vladimir, a former student who now serves the regime.

What follows is a tense psychological battle filled with manipulation, betrayal, and revelations from the past. As the interrogation becomes increasingly personal, Alexei must decide whether to protect his beliefs or say whatever it takes to stay alive. In a world built on fear, the truth comes at a terrible price.

Starring James Franco, Rob Lowe, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Kodi Smit-McPhee, Nick Nolte, and Emile Hirsch.
